content.text:
All three renders are complete and verified.

**Files created** in the working folder:

| File | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | Logo + event name top, portrait beside speaker name/role, large title, footer with date/venue and pill button |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | Two-column: content left (brand → title → speaker → footer), 440px circular portrait right |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | Centered vertical stack: brand, 460px portrait, speaker, title, stacked footer |

`card.html` is the source (one responsive template driven by `?size=`), using `@font-face` for Inter.

**Checks done:**
- Font verified loaded (`document.fonts.check` → true) before every capture, so nothing rendered in a fallback face.
- Portraits use equal width/height with `border-radius:50%` + `object-fit:cover`, so the circle stays perfectly round at every size (no ellipse distortion), with a violet accent ring.
- Title wraps fully in all three — measured `scrollHeight === clientHeight` (zero overflow) on each layout; "on-call" is kept unbreakable so it never splits across lines, and line counts were tuned (3–4 lines) to avoid widows.
- Footer uses `margin-top:auto` so the date/venue and "Get tickets" pill are pinned to the bottom with guaranteed clearance from the title — no overlaps.
- Palette matches spec: `#0F1226` background, white text, `#7C5CFF` accent (used for the eyebrow rule, highlighted word "trust", portrait ring, bullet, button, and bottom gradient bar).
